items.title: Little Big Awesome - Full Series
items.description: Little Big Awesome follows the antics of Gluko and Lennon, the two best friends ever. Seriously, these two are so much better friends than anyone you’ve ever met.  When not busy being BFF’s, the two endeavor to help their friends in Townopolis live their best lives.
